paragraphs.zh: Thiadiazol-2-yl, 1,3,4-Triazol-2-yl. Beispiele für 6-gliedriges Heteroaryl sind 2-Pyridinyl, 3-Pyridinyl, 4-Pyridinyl, 3-Pyridazinyl, 4-Pyridazinyl, 2-Pyrimidinyl, 4-Pyrimidinyl, 5-Pyrimidinyl, 2-Pyrazinyl, 1,3,5-Triazin-2-yl, 1,2,4-Triazin-3-yl und 1,2,4,5-Tetrazin-3-yl. Beispiele für anneliertes 5-gliedriges Heteroaryl sind Benzothiazol-2-yl und Benzoxazol-2-yl. Beispiele für benzokondensierte 6-gliedriges Heteroaryl sind Chinolin, Isochinolin, Chinazolin und Chinoxalin.
paragraphs.en: Thiadiazol-2-yl, 1,3,4-triazol-2-yl. Examples of 6-membered heteroaryl are 2-pyridinyl, 3-pyridinyl, 4-pyridinyl, 3-pyridazinyl, 4-pyridazinyl, 2-pyrimidinyl, 4-pyrimidinyl, 5-pyrimidinyl, 2-pyrazinyl, 1,3,5-triazin-2-yl, 1,2,4-triazin-3-yl and 1,2,4,5-tetrazin-3-yl. Examples of annelated 5-membered heteroaryl are benzothiazol-2-yl and benzoxazol-2-yl. Examples of benzo-fused 6-membered heteroaryl are quinoline, isoquinoline, quinazoline and quinoxaline.
paragraphs.notes: Page-top continuation: this paragraph starts mid-sentence in a list that begins on the previous page, and no paragraph markers of the [00NN] kind are printed anywhere in this publication, so the marker field carries a positional description instead of a printed marker. HEADER LAYOUT: the header occupies two printed lines, 'WO 00/21924' at the left margin and 'PCT/EP99/06627' at the right margin on the first line, and the printed page number '8' centred on the second line; header and page_label flatten those two lines into one with runs of spaces, because page_label is emitted inside a single-line HTML comment downstream. There is a small ink speck in the scan just above the 'a' of '1,2,4-Triazin-3-yl' (third body line) and a similar speck in the left margin beside 'WO 00/21924'; both are scanner dirt that obscures nothing, and no character on this page is unreadable. 'benzokondensierte 6-gliedriges' is printed with that case-mismatched adjective pair and is transcribed as printed, not corrected. The four examples in the last sentence are printed as ring names (Chinolin, Isochinolin, Chinazolin, Chinoxalin) rather than as yl radicals, unlike every other example in the paragraph; see discrepancies. The English lower-cases the substituent names per English chemical-nomenclature convention while the German keeps its printed capitals.

paragraphs.zh: Die Angabe “partiell oder vollständig halogeniert“ soll zum Ausdruck bringen, daß in den derart charakterisierten Gruppen die Wasserstoffatome zum Teil oder vollständig durch gleiche oder verschiedene Halogenatome wie vorstehend genannt ersetzt sein können.
paragraphs.en: The expression "partially or fully halogenated" is intended to express that in the groups so characterised the hydrogen atoms may be replaced in part or in full by identical or different halogen atoms as mentioned above.
paragraphs.notes: Quotation marks: both marks around the quoted phrase are RAISED marks sitting at cap height, verified at 12x magnification. The opening mark is clearly a curled 66-shaped double quote (U+201C); the closing mark is also raised, with two nearly straight ticks, and is transcribed as U+201C as well, which is the German ...“ closing convention. It is deliberately NOT normalised to a straight ASCII quote or to a low-9 opening quote. Downstream passes must not read meaning into the exact quote glyph on this page. The eszett in 'daß' is the pre-1996-reform spelling used throughout this patent and is kept as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Ist eine Gruppe mehrfach substituiert, so ist darunter zu verstehen, daß bei der Kombination der verschiedenen Substituenten die allgemeinen Grundsätze des Aufbaus chemischer Verbindungen zu beachten sind, d.h. daß nicht Verbindungen gebildet werden, von denen der Fachmann weiß, daß sie chemisch instabil oder nicht möglich sind.
paragraphs.en: If a group is polysubstituted, this is to be understood as meaning that in combining the various substituents the general principles of the construction of chemical compounds are to be observed, i.e. that no compounds are formed which the person skilled in the art knows to be chemically unstable or impossible.
paragraphs.notes: 'd.h.' is printed without a space between the two abbreviated words and is kept that way.

paragraphs.zh: Die Verbindungen  der allgemeinen Formel I können je nach Art und Verknüpfung der Substituenten als Stereoisomere vorliegen. Sind beispielsweise eine oder mehrere Alkenylgruppen vorhanden, so können Diastereomere auftreten. Sind beispielsweise ein oder mehrere asymmetrische Kohlenstoffatome vorhanden, so können Enantiomere und Diastereomere auftreten. Stereoisomere lassen sich aus den bei der Herstellung anfallenden Gemischen nach üblichen Trennmethoden, beispielsweise durch chromatographische Trennverfahren, erhalten. Ebenso können Stereoisomere durch Einsatz stereoselektiver Reaktionen unter Verwendung optisch aktiver Ausgangs- und/oder Hilfsstoffe selektiv hergestellt werden. Die Erfindung betrifft auch alle Stereoisomeren und deren Gemische, die von der allgemeinen Formel I umfaßt, jedoch nicht spezifisch definiert sind.
paragraphs.en: Depending on the nature and linkage of the substituents, the compounds of the general formula I may be present as stereoisomers. If, for example, one or more alkenyl groups are present, diastereomers may occur. If, for example, one or more asymmetric carbon atoms are present, enantiomers and diastereomers may occur. Stereoisomers can be obtained from the mixtures arising in the preparation by customary separation methods, for example by chromatographic separation processes. Likewise, stereoisomers can be prepared selectively by employing stereoselective reactions using optically active starting materials and/or auxiliaries. The invention also relates to all stereoisomers and mixtures thereof which are encompassed by the general formula I but are not specifically defined.
paragraphs.notes: Two spaces are printed between 'Verbindungen' and 'der' in the first line, a typesetting artifact reproduced verbatim. 'umfaßt' is the pre-reform spelling as printed. The general formula is referred to by the roman numeral I; it is not drawn on this page.

paragraphs.zh: Für die Auswahl der Bedeutungen von "Y" und "Z" soll gelten, daß "Y" und "Z" nicht gleichzeitig jeweils für eine heteroatomige divalente Einheit stehen.
paragraphs.en: For the selection of the meanings of "Y" and "Z" it shall apply that "Y" and "Z" do not simultaneously each stand for a heteroatom-containing divalent unit.
paragraphs.notes: The marks around Y and Z here are STRAIGHT vertical double quotes at cap height, visibly different from the curled raised marks used in the second paragraph, and are transcribed as ASCII '"'. Last paragraph on the page; the lower third of the page is blank.
